## Goal

Finalize product requirements and initialize technical foundations without overbuilding.

## Tasks

- [ ] Confirm MVP user flows
- [ ] Define authentication requirements
- [ ] Finalize Firestore v1 schema
- [ ] Decide Firebase environment strategy
- [ ] Prepare mobile app initialization plan
- [ ] Prepare backend initialization plan

## Done When

- [ ] MVP scope is documented
- [ ] Auth rules are defined

- [ ] Environment strategy is documented
